agent-browser v0.43.0
Upstream: https://github.com/vercel-labs/agent-browser
License: Apache License, Version 2.0; upstream LICENSE is distributed alongside this file.

Job Search Assistant embedding patch level 1, 2026-11-18:
- Add an offline --job-assistant-probe capability report.
- Require valid JOB_ASSISTANT_EMBEDDED / JOB_ASSISTANT_STREAM_TOKEN settings.
- Authenticate the original session stream WebSocket handshake using Bearer credentials.
- Disable the original stream HTTP routes and WebSocket browser input in embedding mode.
- Authenticate native CLI-to-daemon commands and strip credentials before dispatch or broadcast.
- Preserve upstream JPEG capture, frame pacing and rendering acknowledgements.
- Add JOB_ASSISTANT_EXISTING_DAEMON=1 to refuse daemon startup/replacement during bound operations.
- Preserve existing tabs during embedded auto-connect; report an empty eligible tab set without creating a page.
- Refuse a first pinned embedded attach without a selected target instead of implicitly creating a tab.
- Skip Runtime.enable subscriptions in embedding mode because the application does not consume console/error events; keep direct Runtime command responses and exceptions unchanged.

The embedding environment variables and probe are additions of this project,
not options provided by the unmodified upstream distribution.
